title: gate_run
description: One run of the stop gate in a writer's slot finished: the repo's gate commands ran, or the gate never got a turn. Written by the loop from the companion's gate lines. Not a stage and not progress. A retried write can repeat it: count one per (issue, life, seq, started_at). A pass row can carry flaky once the loop has checked it: flaky is true when the run just before it, in the same issue and life, failed on the same head and both slots were clean (so the same code passed after failing).

life.description: Which life of the issue the gate ran in.

seq.description: The record's sequence in this life whose writer step ran the gate.

head.description: The slot's HEAD commit when the gate ran; null when it could not be read.

result.description: pass, fail (a command exited non-zero), or unknown (the gate could not run: its budget ran out, a command did not start, or it never got a turn within the wait cap).

wait_ms.description: How long the gate waited for a turn, in milliseconds; 0 when it took a turn at once or there is no limit.

run_ms.description: How long the gate ran once it held a turn, in milliseconds; 0 when it never ran.

concurrency.description: How many gates could run at once when this one asked for a turn; null when there was no limit.

queued_behind.description: How many gates held a turn or waited ahead of this one when it asked; 0 when it took a turn at once.

started_at.description: When the gate asked for its turn (before any wait).

flaky.description: Set on a pass row once the loop has checked it. True means the run just before it, in the same issue and life, failed on the same head, and both slots were clean; false means it was checked and is not a flake. Null when not checked or not a pass.

failed_tests.description: The failing tests' names on a fail row; on a flaky pass row the names from the fail before it. Null when none were recorded.

failed_at.description: On a flaky pass row, when the failed run started. Null otherwise.

mem_start_bytes.description: The container's memory in use (cgroup memory.current) when the gate started to run, in bytes. Container-wide: at concurrency above 1 it includes other gates. Left out when not read.

mem_peak_bytes.description: The highest memory.current sampled (every 5 s, and at the end) while the gate ran, in bytes. Left out when not read.

mem_limit_bytes.description: The cgroup's memory.max when the gate ran, in bytes; left out when there is no limit or it was not read.
